final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS overall_avg FROM order_avgs), above_overall AS (SELECT oa.avg_remain, o.overall_avg FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE oa.avg_remain > o.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS group_avg FROM above_overall), selected AS (SELECT a.avg_remain, a.overall_avg, g.group_avg FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_avg g WHERE a.avg_remain > g.group_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_remain), AVG(avg_remain - overall_avg), AVG(avg_remain - group_avg) FROM selected
